source_kind: hand-built from company docs icon (400 px)
edits: built by hand from exact geometry fitted to the official raster (hand_constructed; construction and measures below)
viewBox cropped to the drawing (2% pad), one viewBox for both theme files
light mode: the same drawing without the pale #f1f2fc disc, which is invisible on the light tile (a proposal for review)
notes: DECISION (brand colour): Spydra's pale disc vanishes on the light tile; proposed light file is the spider alone, the dark file keeps the disc as Spydra draws it. Alternative: the disc in both themes.

hand.construction: four polylines of one 13.25 px stroke with round caps and joins (each a vertical, a knee, an apex on the centre line and its mirror), the end points on quarter pixels, over a circle
hand.verification: every measure at the source's own resolution: silhouette IoU, boundary F within 1 source px, the largest boundary distance in source px, the share of the interior more than CIEDE2000 3 off, SSIM at 22/48/96 px on the app's four tiles, fills sampled from the source; then the SVG drawn at 384 px and inspected for wobbles
hand.variant: light mode: the same drawing without the pale #f1f2fc disc, which is invisible on the light tile (a proposal for review)
